scope: Independent verification of signed externally stored custody roots, outside signer trust allowlisting, Ed25519 signature validation, anti-rollback CheckpointTracker, FileCheckpointStore adapter, and ledger rewrite detection

observations: CreateCheckpoint and VerifyCheckpoint in internal/custody/checkpoints.go implement independent cryptographic attestations for custody roots at specific sequence numbers.

Signer trust is strictly enforced out-of-band via opts.TrustedPublicKeys; any signer key omitted from or mismatched against the outside allowlist fails closed with ErrCheckpointUntrustedSigner (untrusted_signer).

Deterministic Ed25519 signature verification over canonical bytes breachatlas:checkpoint:v1:{fields} detects any payload or signature modification with ErrCheckpointInvalidSignature (invalid_signature).
Expired checkpoints are rejected with ErrCheckpointExpired (expired_checkpoint) when verification time exceeds ExpiresAt.
CheckpointTracker enforces monotonic anti-rollback and anti-replay invariants, rejecting stale revisions (ErrCheckpointStaleRevision) while retaining accepted authority state.

Ledger rewrite detection compares the independent checkpoint root against the ledger event root at the declared sequence; modifying historical events on disk causes VerifyCheckpoint to detect ledger tampering and fail closed with ErrCheckpointRootMismatch (root_mismatch).
Missing evidence or sequence numbers not present in the custody ledger fail with ErrCheckpointMissingEvidence (missing_evidence).
FileCheckpointStore provides durable crash-resilient local filesystem checkpoint persistence with path containment and symlink protection.
Sealed evidence source bytes are verified to remain bit-for-bit identical before, during, and after checkpoint operations.
